europe_now.title: Microsoft Outlook Global Outage
europe_now.summary: A major global technology disruption impacted Microsoft Outlook services across Europe and numerous other countries for over 18 hours. While companies and institutions worked to restore standard operations, officials confirmed there were no immediate indications of a cyberattack.

sources.headline: 🔴 Live: Microsoft reports 'improvements' to Outlook services in North America, Europe
Microsoft services are beginning to return to normal after global outage of over 18 hours

europe_now.title: Ukraine Peace Diplomacy and Conflict Developments
europe_now.summary: Diplomatic efforts surrounding the war in Ukraine continued as discussions advanced regarding European involvement in upcoming peace talks. Meanwhile, intense military activity persisted across the region as heavy drone launches and ongoing airstrikes were reported.

top_stories.title: Privacy Penalties and Regulatory Enforcement
top_stories.summary: Regulatory authorities have issued a substantial privacy fine against the owner of Tinder for data compliance violations. European institutions continue to monitor corporate data practices and enforce strict digital privacy standards across the bloc.

sources.headline: Tinder owner hit with €11M privacy fine

top_stories.title: Ukrainian Refugees Navigating Long-Term Integration
top_stories.summary: Ukrainian refugees residing in Poland are increasingly confronting the realities of long-term settlement as displacement persists. Host communities and local agencies are adapting their support frameworks to address extended residency needs.
